1.author: agent
1.text: Added public API/options/error contracts test-first; focused suite plus full refc and ORC suites pass. Empty and mem:// factories work, unknown schemes raise InvalidBackendUrlError, lifecycle is idempotent, and the documented abstract surface type-checks.

2.author: agent
2.text: Added focused memory KV contract tests and InMemoryKvStore. Verified missing/empty distinction, binary-safe round trips, overwrite, delete booleans, exists agreement, and empty-key validation. Focused tests and full refc/ORC suites pass without network.

3.author: agent
3.text: Implemented lazy TTL with an injected monotonic clock seam. Deterministic tests cover persistent entries, positive expiry, overwrite resetting TTL, negative TTL preserving the old value, and expired get/exists/increment behavior. Focused and full refc/ORC suites pass.

4.author: agent
4.text: Implemented bounded deterministic LRU with read/overwrite recency refresh, expired-entry purge before eviction, lexical key tie-break, and positive-capacity validation. Focused tests explicitly cover every criterion; full refc and ORC suites pass.

5.author: agent
5.text: Implemented signed 64-bit atomic increments without awaits between read/write. Tests cover missing→1, monotonic and negative values, int64 boundary behavior, invalid/overflow preservation, and 200 interleaved increments. Focused plus refc/ORC suites pass.

6.author: agent
6.text: Implemented snapshot-based in-process Pub/Sub with unique opaque subscriptions, exact routing/counts, idempotent unsubscribe, ordered per-subscription queues, callback-safe subscription mutation, isolated/redacted handler errors, and close-time task draining. Focused plus refc/ORC suites pass.

7.author: agent
7.text: Completed lifecycle/state behavior: immediate connected and terminal closed notifications, no memory disconnect states, typed post-close failures, idempotent close, active worker cancellation-and-drain, and subscription shutdown. Focused lifecycle tests and full refc/ORC suites pass.

8.author: agent
8.text: Extracted reusable factory-driven KV and Pub/Sub contract suites under tests/contract. Memory now runs portable behavior only through those harnesses; memory-specific tests cover injected-clock/LRU/cancellation internals. A deliberately broken KV fake is detected across missing-get, round-trip, delete, and increment probes. Full refc/ORC suites pass.

9.author: agent
9.text: Completed Phase 1 release gate: expanded README with KV/TTL/PubSub/errors/shutdown and event-loop boundaries, added and ran the public memory example, fixed nimble testFile, ran refc+ORC twice, validated nimble package metadata, committed 5389378, and created annotated v0.1.0. No external publish was performed.

10.author: agent
10.text: Implemented RESP2 recursive value model and byte-exact encoder for simple/error/integer/binary+nil bulk/nested+nil arrays, plus injection-safe bulk-framed command encoding. Focused fixtures and full refc/ORC suites pass.

11.author: agent
11.text: Implemented bounded incremental RESP2 parser with arbitrary fragmentation, all-boundary splits, concatenated frames, nil/empty distinction, nested arrays, strict lengths, bulk/array/depth/line limits, malformed CRLF detection, and explicit finish-time truncation errors. Focused and full refc/ORC suites pass.

12.author: agent
12.text: Implemented strict Redis URL parsing for defaults, password/ACL auth, percent decoding, IPv4/IPv6, port/database validation, unsupported rediss, and missing credentials. RedisConfig formatting omits credentials and all parse errors are generic/redacted. Focused plus refc/ORC suites pass.

13.author: agent
13.text: Implemented one-lock serialized Redis command connection over Chronos streams with bounded connect/handshake/command waits, AUTH variants, SELECT/PING readiness, typed auth/server/protocol/timeout/connection errors, cancellation preservation, idempotent close, no replay of ambiguous commands, and reconnect on the next operation. Scripted-server focused tests plus full refc/ORC suites pass.

14.author: agent
14.text: Implemented RedisKvStore GET/SET[/EX]/DEL/EXISTS/INCR mappings and redis:// factory selection. The unchanged KV contract now includes real TTL and passes against both memory and local Redis 7.2.5 under refc and ORC; focused mapping tests also pass.

15.author: agent
15.text: Implemented RedisPubSub with a serialized PUBLISH connection and separate authenticated subscriber transport/reader, acknowledgement-driven SUBSCRIBE/UNSUBSCRIBE, exact routing, shared server subscription for multiple local handlers, isolated handler delivery, and typed lifecycle. Unchanged Pub/Sub contract and focused real-Redis tests pass under refc/ORC.

16.author: agent
16.text: Added subscriber reconnect state machine with disconnected/connected notifications, capped exponential backoff plus jitter, desired/live channel separation, offline subscription changes, automatic resubscription without duplicates, and close-safe backoff cancellation. Fault-injected real-Redis tests and full refc/ORC integration suites pass.

17.author: agent
17.text: Hardened total RESP buffering, subscriber handshake/write deadlines, lock-wait cancellation, ambiguous-I/O teardown, and payload sanitization even when handler exception messages contain the payload. Existing fault-injection covers stalled/malformed/disconnected/cancelled command and reconnect stages; full memory+Redis refc/ORC suites pass with generic credential/payload-free diagnostics.

18.author: agent
18.text: CI now provisions a health-checked Redis 7 service and runs the complete unchanged memory+Redis suite for refc and ORC with REDIS_TEST_URL mandatory. AUTH/SELECT and bounded reconnect scenarios are covered; CI also performs a bounded Redis container restart and reruns the suite. Local Redis 7.2.5 matrix passes under both memory managers.

19.author: agent
19.text: Added examples/backendswitch.nim using only the umbrella API and one URL environment variable. Compiled it once, ran the identical binary with mem:// and redis://127.0.0.1:6379/15, and diff confirmed identical observable KV/PubSub output. It contains no backend imports, type checks, or conditional call sites.

20.author: agent
20.text: Completed stable 1.0.0 API/release review, Redis README examples, timeout/reconnect operations guidance, compatibility table, changelog, and package/version bump. From clean clone 9e535c7, dependency install, memory refc/ORC, mandatory Redis refc/ORC, and nimble check all pass. The umbrella exports only the backend-neutral API/factories; deployment activation requires only Redis plus the URL. Final annotated tag is created in the release-finalization step.

21.author: agent
21.text: Added a scripted queued-command/close race test. RedisConnection now marks close terminal immediately, serializes teardown on the command lock, and rechecks closed state after lock acquisition. Focused test and full real-Redis refc/ORC suites pass; queued/new commands fail BackendClosedError and repeated close remains idempotent.

22.author: agent
22.text: The unchanged KV contract now proves set-with-TTL → increment → expiry and verifies invalid/overflow increments preserve value. InMemoryKvStore retains the existing expiresAt while replacing the numeric value. Memory and real Redis contracts pass under refc and ORC.

23.author: agent
23.text: Defined publish result as active local subscriptions on the current PubSub instance. Shared contracts cover 0/1/2 and unsubscribe; Redis-specific coverage proves another Redis client does not affect the count. Same-binary mem/Redis output diff and full refc/ORC integration pass.

24.author: agent
24.text: Reconnect now keeps transport/parser candidates local until handshake plus full reconciliation succeeds and closes every candidate on failure/cancellation. Sustained real-process outage and repeated reconnect tests pass, with clean close under refc/ORC.

25.author: agent
25.text: Subscriber operations now carry one absolute deadline through lock acquisition, write, and ACK wait; timed-out/cancelled ambiguous attempts close the subscriber and clean pending ACK state. Close fails all pending futures. Full timeout/cancellation/reconnect suites pass refc/ORC.

26.author: agent
26.text: Added an actual sustained outage contract. Locally it launches isolated Redis, stops it across multiple backoffs, observes disconnected, restarts, requires connected and exact delivery, then closes while down; this passed. CI runs the analogous Docker service stop/start scenario under refc and ORC.

27.author: agent
27.text: Added configurable maxInlineBytes and identical enforcement before/after CRLF discovery. Long simple/error/integer/length fixtures pass whole, bytewise, and every split; over-limit fragmented and whole inputs fail. Focused plus full refc/ORC suites pass.

28.author: agent
28.text: Reconnect reconciliation snapshots desired/live keys across awaits, processes every coalesced frame, applies both additions and removals, and loops until desired equals live. Existing offline-change plus sustained real-outage recovery tests converge without duplicate delivery under refc/ORC.

29.author: agent
29.text: RedisConnection now disconnects on cancellation only after lock ownership, so cancelling a queued acquire cannot invalidate active I/O. Scripted test holds ACTIVE, cancels WAITER, then proves ACTIVE and AFTER succeed on the same connection. Full refc/ORC pass.

30.author: agent
30.text: Subscribe/unsubscribe state is now transactional: failed subscribe deactivates/removes its handle and ACK, ambiguous operations close transport, unsubscribe desired state is committed before I/O, and close fails/clears every pending ACK. Reconnect/retry/lifecycle integration passes refc/ORC.

31.author: agent
31.text: Memory and Redis state callbacks now run through one owned ordered queue/worker rather than transport paths. Failures are isolated and close bounds then cancels/drains a stuck observer. Dedicated stuck-observer tests plus reconnect/state contracts pass refc/ORC.

32.author: agent
32.text: Delivery queues are now O(1) deques bounded by public pubSubMaxPendingMessages (default 1024), with documented drop-newest behavior. Workers recheck active state, unsubscribe clears queued payloads and compacts channel/handle tables. Flood/block/unsubscribe focused test and full refc/ORC pass.

33.author: agent
33.text: Non-pipelined command reads now reject multiple replies as ProtocolError and close; scripted surplus-reply test passes. Reconnect reconciliation feeds every parsed subscriber frame through the dispatcher, retaining ACK+message coalescing. Full Pub/Sub recovery suites pass refc/ORC.

34.author: agent
34.text: Redis commands now compute one absolute operation deadline and pass remaining budgets through lock, establish/connect/handshake, and reply. Resolution failures map to BackendConnectionError; connectTimeout is capped by remaining operation budget. Focused typed-DNS/elapsed-bound test and refc/ORC suites pass.

35.author: agent
35.text: Each RedisPubSub now owns an entropy-seeded Rand; production jitter uses that instance. BackendOptions exposes deterministic reconnectJitterSource injection with clamped range for tests. Focused reconnect test proves injection/cap use; full recovery refc/ORC passes.

36.author: agent
36.text: Expanded broken-backend evidence to KV and Pub/Sub probes, strengthened portable count/lifecycle/TTL/fragmentation/timeout/outage cases, and made CI execute password-only plus ACL Redis under refc/ORC with verified sustained restart. Same compiled backend-switch binary was diffed mem vs Redis locally; full matrices and nimble check pass.
